text: SourceTrail connects articles, claims and sources in a local Relate graph.
An editor withdraws the river survey and records the reason.
Two stories need review. The independent heritage story stays current.
The economy digest cites the withdrawn survey. Relate finds this indirect dependency.
A review cannot clear evidence while its upstream source is still flagged.
A corrected source is available, but earlier evidence reviews remain stale.
After human review, the business story is current. Another story still needs attention.
Articles share claims and evidence. Each source change follows those relationships.
Changes and reviews persist locally. No cloud account, API key or model call is needed.
